title: 2 BR Near Broadway + Free Parking | Apt A
description:
Stay close to the best of Nashville in this comfortable 2BR, 1BA apartment just minutes from Broadway and downtown. Enjoy FREE private parking, fast Wi-Fi, a full kitchen, in-unit washer/dryer and easy self check-in. Perfect for couples, friends, families and business travelers. Located in a safe and quiet neighborhood. Convenient to The Gulch, Music Row, Midtown, Vanderbilt, area hospitals and Marathon Village. A comfy and cozy Nashville home base for up to 4 guests.

The space
**Welcome to your Nashville home base!**

Quiet, safe area close to downtown. Plenty of free private parking right next to the building.

Whether you're visiting Music City for a weekend getaway, a concert, a sporting event, a business trip, health needs, or a stay near Vanderbilt, you'll love the convenience of this comfortable 2-bedroom, 1-bath furnished apartment.

Located just 8 minutes from Broadway and downtown Nashville, you'll be close to the action while enjoying a comfortable place to relax and recharge after a day of exploring.

**Why you'll love staying here:**

• 2 comfortable bedrooms — perfect for couples, friends, families, or business travelers
• 8 minutes to Broadway & downtown Nashville
• Free parking — a valuable convenience in Nashville
• Full kitchen — prepare breakfast, snacks, or a meal during your stay
• Washer & dryer — ideal for longer stays
• Convenient to The Gulch, Midtown, Music Row, and Vanderbilt University and Medical Center
• Easy access to area hospitals and medical centers
• Convenient to Marathon Motor Works and other popular Nashville destinations

** Location, Location, Location**

Spend the day exploring Nashville's famous honky-tonks and live music venues on Broadway, then head back to your comfortable apartment for a relaxing evening.

You're also conveniently located for exploring The Gulch's restaurants and nightlife, Music Row's legendary music history, Midtown's vibrant atmosphere, and Vanderbilt University. Whether you're in town for a concert, a university visit, a medical appointment, or simply to experience Nashville, this location makes it easy to get where you need to go.

**Everything You Need for a Comfortable Stay**

After a busy day in Music City, come home to a space where you can relax and feel at home in a quiet and safe area. The full kitchen gives you the flexibility to prepare your own meals, while the in-unit washer and dryer make longer stays easy and convenient.

And with free parking, you can enjoy the flexibility of having your vehicle without the hassle and expense of searching for parking downtown.

**Your Nashville Adventure Starts Here**

From Broadway and downtown to The Gulch, Music Row, Midtown, Vanderbilt, and Marathon Motor Works, this apartment puts you close to many of Nashville's most popular destinations.

Guest access
You have the entire place to yourselves. We have electronic keypad door locks (no key needed) so you can self check-in when it is convenient for you. Your unique door code will be sent to you after booking.

Other things to note
Free Private parking is available in the surface gravel parking lot located right next to the building. We can easily accommodate for you two full-sized vehicles (SUV's, pickup trucks, cars, etc). If you will have more than two vehicles let us know as we may be able to accommodate you based on how many vehicles our other guests are bringing.
